pr_comments:
I think there are other kinds of exports that are still failing with this solution. Try adding this to the end of `continuous-exports/index.js` (without a linebreak)

```
export { FunctionFromOtherFile } from './otherFile'; 
```

Result will be:

> `TypeError: __vite_ssr_import_10__.SecondClass is not a constructor`
Not an elegant solution, but it does the trick, it is better to find the root cause and fix it, see my https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/6395#issuecomment-1007995452

As described in my verbose [#6395 (comment)](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/6395#issuecomment-1025300105) I think the (mis)use of `s.appendRight()` is indeed the root cause here and there's no upstream bug nor a broad structural bug.

The `node.end` → `node.start` replacements shouldn't be necessary and are resulting in odd ordering. (e.g. It produces the export of class B before the class itself in that last test.)

I believe the result is cleanest with only the `s.appendRight()` → `s.appendLeft()` fix and the transplant of its newline to the end of the string.

(I'd be happy to provide a patch or a separate PR if that would be the best way.)

@ygj6 Sorry I wasn't clearer about that part! My point was the changes of `node.end` to `node.start` in `ssrTransform.ts` should be omitted, I think. AFAICT they don't improve anything and in fact they result in odd ordering. (Note the exports of classes before class definitions in some of the updated snapshots.)
@neb Sorry I misunderstood you earlier, now that I understand, I pushed the latest code, let's see if that's correct.

issue_context.title: Doesn't export function in SSR if there is other exported function right after
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

This code after Vite SSR transformations doesn't export the first function:

```js
// example.js
export function first() {
  console.log('t')
}export function second() {
  return 'r'
}
```

If you start `second` at new line, it will export `first`.

### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vite-luccje?file=test.test.js

### System Info

```shell
System:
    OS: macOS 12.0.1
    CPU: (8) x64 Apple M1
    Memory: 33.58 MB / 8.00 GB

    Yarn: 1.22.17 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v16.7.0/bin/yarn
    npm: 6.14.15 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v16.7.0/bin/npm

    Safari: 15.1
  npmPackages:
    @vitejs/plugin-react: ^1.0.7 => 1.1.4

```
